info.title: Cominty API
info.description: The HTTP API behind the Cominty Python SDK: chat and threads, memory, MCP integrations, agents, skills, document sources, and documents. Send your API key in the x-cominty-token header.

parameters.name: disconnected
parameters.description: Filter on sources whose connection is lost. A drag-and-drop source has no connection, so it is never disconnected.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: true keeps only the archived sources, false hides them. Omit it to list both.

schema.title: Response Get Sources Dc Sources Get

get.description: List the sources created by the key's user, plus the organization-scoped sources. Archived sources are included. Pass archived to keep only the archived ones (true) or to hide them (false). A source has two ids: id is a number, the one capabilities take in source_ids. pid is a string, the one every path takes.

post.description: Index the files of a drive as a source. With an API key, store must be draganddrop and config.drive_id is the id of a drive you created. The first sync starts at once: the response has status pending or syncing. Poll GET /dc/sources until the status is synced before you search it. googledrive and sharepoint need the console's OAuth flow and return 400 Store not available for API keys. A missing or unknown drive returns 400 Invalid config.drive_id. The source is private to the key's user.

parameters.name: source_pid
parameters.description: Public id of the source (the pid field, a string).

put.description: Rename a source. The drive of a drag-and-drop source cannot change.

parameters.name: source_pid
parameters.description: Public id of the source (the pid field, a string).

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: start, pause, sync or archive. Each one is valid from some statuses only.

put.description: Run an operation on a source: start (only from paused), pause (cancels a running sync), sync (from synced, error, out_of_sync or daily_quota_reached) and archive (from any status but archived). Archiving removes the indexed documents and the files, and cannot be undone. An operation that does not match the current status returns 400 Operation is not valid.

parameters.name: id

schema.description: Composite document id stored in DynamoDB (may contain `#`).
schema.title: Id

parameters.description: Composite document id stored in DynamoDB (may contain `#`).

get.description: Resolve a document id, such as the one in a <cite document_id="..."/> tag of an answer, to its source and file. The id is the source id, a #, and the document's own identifier, so URL-encode it. There is no list: an unknown id returns 404 Not Found.

parameters.name: drive_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the drive.

get.description: Fetch a drive and its files. A drive created by another user returns 404 Not Found, even in the same organization.

post.description: Create an empty drive: the container that holds the files of a source. The drive belongs to the user who created the key. A user has at most 100 drives, and a drive cannot be deleted. The 101st returns 400 Too many drives.

parameters.name: drive_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the drive that receives the file.

parameters.name: mimetype
parameters.description: Media type of the file.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: File name. It cannot contain a slash.

get.description: First step of a file upload to a drive. Returns a presigned url and form fields. Upload the file to that url, a storage host, as multipart/form-data with the fields. Do not send x-cominty-token to the storage host. filename cannot contain a slash. A drive holds at most 50 files: past that, the call returns 400 Too many files, or Too many pending files.

post.description: Last step of a file upload to a drive. Send the ETag from the storage response and the key from the upload permission. The response is the file. Its id is what GET /files/{file_pid} and DELETE /files/{file_pid} take.

parameters.name: file_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the file.

schema.title: Response Download File Files  File Pid  Get

get.description: Returns a presigned download URL as a JSON string, not the file bytes. The URL expires after 5 minutes: fetch it right away, and do not send x-cominty-token to the storage host. A file created by another user returns 404 Not Found.

parameters.name: file_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the file.

schema.title: Response Delete File Files  File Pid  Delete

delete.description: Delete a file from its drive, with its stored object. Success is 200 with a null body. The source that indexes the drive does not re-read it until you request a sync with PUT /dc/sources/{source_pid}/status.

get.description: List the MCP integrations this API key can use. A server's name is the value to store in capabilities.mcp.connections. Servers that are off are listed with is_enabled false.

List the built-in agents, the organization agents, and the private agents of the user who created the key. A private agent of another member is not listed. Items are summaries: they carry no instructions and no models. Call GET /agents/{agent_pid} for the full agent.

post.description: Create a custom agent. The user who created the API key owns it: owner is that user's id, not the key's. scope is private (the owner only) or organization (every member). Omit model_ids to use the organization's default model chain. A capability you omit gets its default. capabilities.mcp.connections takes the name values of GET /mcp/manifest, and capabilities.skills.include takes skill ids (an id the key cannot read returns 422). Legacy fields are deprecated: use capabilities instead.

get.description: Models selectable when building a custom agent (id and name only).

schema.title: Response Get Available Models Agents Models Get

parameters.name: agent_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the agent.

get.description: Fetch one agent with its instructions and model chain. An unknown id, an agent of another organization, and a private agent of another member all return 404 Not Found.

parameters.name: agent_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the agent.

put.description: Update an agent. Send only the fields you want to change. A JSON null clears description, instructions and capabilities. capabilities is merged capability by capability: each one you send replaces the stored one, the others stay. A built-in agent, an agent of another organization, and a private agent of another member return 404 Not Found. An organization agent owned by someone else can be updated.

parameters.name: agent_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the agent.

delete.description: Delete an agent permanently. Success is 204 with no body. Messages the agent already handled keep working. Deleting twice, or deleting a built-in agent, returns 404.

parameters.name: agent_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the agent.

put.description: Replace the agent's model chain. The first model answers, and the next ones take over when it fails. An unknown id returns 404 Bad model_ids. An empty list returns 422. On a built-in agent this changes the chain of the whole organization for that agent.

parameters.name: file_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the conversation file.

schema.title: Response Chat Download Conversation File Chat Files  File Pid  Get

get.description: Returns a presigned download URL as a JSON string, not the file bytes. Fetch that URL directly. Do not send x-cominty-token to the storage host.

parameters.name: mimetype
parameters.description: Media type of the file.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: File name. At most 255 characters, and it cannot contain a slash.

get.description: First step of a file upload. Returns a presigned url and form fields. Upload the file to that url, a storage host rather than ds.cominty.com, as multipart/form-data. Do not send x-cominty-token to the storage host. filename is at most 255 characters and cannot contain a slash.

post.description: Last step of a file upload. Send the ETag from the storage response and the key from the upload permission. The response is a conversation file. Use its id as file_ids on a chat message.

Start a conversation and post the first message. The response is the full thread. Send options.agent_id and options.user_id. options.capabilities overrides some of the agent's capabilities for the whole life of the thread, memory included. Each capability you send replaces the agent's value entirely, and the others keep the agent's value. message.scope turns a capability on or off, or narrows its allowlist, for this first message only. Omit options.capabilities and the thread follows the agent. options.max_steps caps the tool rounds of the first assistant message. Omit it and the server applies its default, currently 60.

get.description: List threads for one end user. An API token requires user_id and lists that user's API sessions. limit defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 100. page is zero-based. terms is a free-text search of at most 10 strings.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: End user whose threads to list. Required for an API token.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Product surface of the threads. An API token always lists api sessions, so you can omit this.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 50. Maximum 100.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index.

parameters.name: terms
parameters.description: Free-text search terms. At most 10 strings.

parameters.name: thread_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the thread.

get.description: Fetch one thread, including its messages.

parameters.name: thread_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the thread.

put.description: Rename a thread or star it. The response is a summary and does not include messages. Send only the fields you want to change.

parameters.name: thread_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the thread.

schema.title: Response Archive Thread Chat  Thread Id  Delete

delete.description: Archive a thread. This does not delete its messages.

parameters.name: thread_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the thread.

post.description: Post a message in an existing thread. The response is the new message, not the thread. message.scope narrows the thread's capabilities for this message only: it can turn one off, or shrink an allowlist, but never widen them. options.capabilities is rejected with 422: the thread's capabilities, memory included, were frozen when it started. options.max_steps caps the tool rounds of this message only. Omit it and the server default applies again, not the value of the previous message.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the message to export.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: pdf or docx.

get.description: Export a message as a PDF or DOCX. The response body is the file bytes, not JSON, and carries no file name. format is pdf or docx. A message with no content, for example one still running, returns 400 Message has no content.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the assistant message to stream.

parameters.name: last-event-id
parameters.description: Resume the stream after this event. Omit it to start from the beginning.

get.description: Stream an assistant reply as JSONL events. Send the Last-Event-ID header to resume after a dropped connection.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the in-flight assistant message.

post.description: Cancel an in-flight assistant message. The response is the message with status cancelled. A message that is not running (finished, failed, already cancelled, or a user message) returns 400 Message is not live, so a second cancel always fails.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: If set, only files in this namespace. If omitted, every file visible to the API token. At most 128 characters.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Optional. Does not select the memory namespace.

schema.title: Response List Memory Files Memory Get

get.description: List memory files visible to this API token. Each item is a summary and does not include content. Pass namespace to limit the list to one namespace. Omit it to list every namespace in the organization.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Optional. Does not select the memory namespace. The namespace belongs in the JSON body.

post.description: Create a file in a namespace. With an API token, namespace is required and omitting it returns 400 Missing namespace. path, purpose, and content are required. path has at most one folder segment. content may be empty. Creating a path that already exists in that namespace returns 409.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Optional. Does not select which namespaces are listed.

schema.title: Response List Memory Namespaces Memory Namespaces Get

get.description: List namespace names that already contain at least one file. A name appears when the first file is created in it, and disappears when its last file is deleted. There is no separate call to create or delete a namespace.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative path with at most one folder segment, for example notes/todo.md. a/b/todo.md returns 422.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Namespace the file belongs to. Required for an API token. Omitting it returns 400 Missing namespace. At most 128 characters.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Optional. Does not select the memory namespace.

get.description: Fetch one file, including its content. With an API token, namespace is required. A missing file returns 404.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative path with at most one folder segment, for example notes/todo.md. a/b/todo.md returns 422.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Opaque token from the last read of this file. A stale value returns 409. A malformed value returns 422. Send it back unchanged.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Namespace the file belongs to. Required for an API token. Omitting it returns 400 Missing namespace. At most 128 characters.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Optional. Does not select the memory namespace.

put.description: Update content, purpose, or both. With an API token, namespace, path, and version are required. version is the opaque token from the last read. A stale version returns 409. A malformed version returns 422. Send only the fields you want to change. A JSON null leaves the stored value unchanged and still returns 200. There is no way to clear a field.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative path with at most one folder segment, for example notes/todo.md. a/b/todo.md returns 422.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Namespace the file belongs to. Required for an API token. Omitting it returns 400 Missing namespace. At most 128 characters.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Optional. Does not select the memory namespace.

delete.description: Delete one file. With an API token, namespace is required. Success is 204 with no body. Deleting a path that is already gone returns 404.

get.description: List the built-in Cominty skills (source cominty, scope null, read-only), the organization skills, and the skills of the user who created the key. A private skill of another member is not listed.

post.description: Create a custom skill from a zip archive of at most 30 MB, sent as multipart/form-data with display_name (1 to 100 characters), scope and file. SKILL.md opens with YAML frontmatter that follows https://agentskills.io/specification. The zip has SKILL.md at its root, or one top-level folder that holds SKILL.md and nothing else at the root. Any other layout returns 422 with a detail that starts with Invalid zip structure. A bad frontmatter returns 422 with the reason. Success is 201.

parameters.name: skill_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the skill.

put.description: Rename a skill, turn it on or off, or change its scope. Send only the fields you want to change. An inactive skill is kept, but agents stop using it. A built-in skill and a skill the key owner does not own return 404 Not Found.

parameters.name: skill_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the skill.

schema.title: Response Delete Skill Skills  Skill Pid  Delete

delete.description: Delete a skill and every version of it, permanently. Success is 200 with a null body. A built-in skill, a skill the key owner does not own, and a second delete return 404.

parameters.name: skill_pid
parameters.description: Identifier of the skill.

post.description: Upload a new zip for a skill (same layouts as POST /skills). The new version becomes the default, and frontmatter and updated_at describe it. Versions are tagged to the second: two uploads of the same skill within one second collide and return 500, so space them out. Success is 201.
